title: Layout expressive range / vertical stories composition

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Adapt a campaign idea to a tall field while preserving the relationship between people and message.
strategic_value: Shared words, stickers and glyph can connect Instagram’s vertical and landscape communications.
demonstration: Two offset photographs, a white glyph panel and a sticker sit above the Some stories start small headline and signatures.
practical_value: Recompose the ingredients for the tall format instead of shrinking the landscape arrangement.

content_islands.name: Offset picture arrangement
content_islands.spec: Stack two photos diagonally and reserve the upper-right white area for the gradient glyph.

content_islands.name: Message and attribution
content_islands.spec: Place the headline below the collage, with the account and Meta signature at the foot.

reference_purposes.Expression: The irregular collage retains the campaign’s playful character.
reference_purposes.Application: The same campaign phrase appears in a distinct vertical composition.
